description: Pole-mounted gate guardian outside the main 2 Wing gate of AFS Lohegaon next to the station war memorial, visible from the public road (photography discouraged). One of the first MiG-21bis to become a gate guard; earlier in a multi-colour scheme, now overall grey (warbirds.in, Bharat Rakshak database C-2098). Currency: SWAC tweet of 25 Sep 2025 shows MiG-21 farewell ceremony at AFS Pune; gate guard presumed still in place - not separately confirmed 2025.
museum_name: Air Force Station Pune (Lohegaon) gate guard
